$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=5 \\ x_{2} &=2 \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + 5 x_{3} &=18\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & 18\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & 18\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 & 13\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-1)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & 9\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-2)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)R_{3}\end{aligned}
